CONTACT AND PRIVACY

How the form works

This website presents the SprintSpaces app. For questions about the site or submitted inquiries, contact Michał Mleczko at do@mleczki.pl.

What data you send

The form sends your name or company name, email address and message, plus an optional phone number and preferred appointment time. It also indicates that the inquiry came from the SprintSpaces website.

Why we use it

We use these details to reply, discuss your needs and agree a time to talk about deployment. Submitting the form does not automatically book an appointment or subscribe you to a newsletter.

Who handles delivery

When you submit the form, your data is sent to Formspree, which delivers the message. Formspree may also process technical data, such as your IP address, and uses infrastructure in the USA. For details, see the Formspree privacy policy.

The website itself

This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Its code contains no analytics tools, advertising pixels or cookies of its own. The hosting provider may process technical request data according to the GitHub privacy statement.

Live demo

The “Launch a free demo” button sends a random request identifier and the selected sign-in profile from your browser to the demo service. The service does not store your raw IP address: it uses a hash with a secret salt to limit demos per person. In your browser tab, we remember only the request identifier and job token (sessionStorage), so refreshing the page returns to the same demo; the demo URL, username and password are not saved in browser storage. The demo uses fictional data and is deleted after 15 minutes of inactivity, along with everything entered into it. Do not enter real information.

Questions about your data

To ask about data you have sent, correct it or request deletion of correspondence, email do@mleczki.pl. You can also contact us directly by email or phone without using the form.
